title: Conversation Memory Window by Hand
learning_objectives: Fit a conversation into a token budget
Always keep the system message and the latest messages
Replace dropped history with a summary marker
hints: Split off the system message: `head = messages[:1] if messages and messages[0]['role'] == 'system' else []`.
Walk `reversed(rest)` adding while `used + cost <= budget`; stop at the first that doesn't fit.
If dropped > 0: build the marker; while it doesn't fit, pop the oldest kept message (unless only one is left) and recompute n.

failure_feedback.advice: Keep newest messages first; if the marker doesn't fit, drop the oldest kept message.
Count 4 overhead tokens per message, including the marker.
Insert the marker right after the system message when something was dropped.
Only keep a system message if the first message has role 'system'.
